title: The Window That Ate a Century
deck: Three minds enter Illuminara’s wide window to make one decision for a failing world. All three come to prefer the room. Outside, the people excluded from it begin making irreversible choices of their own.
shape: A voluntary deep window becomes a refuge from an irreversible decision.

scenes.title: Before the Door
paragraphs: Ilyon’s northern mirror chain was failing in a way that made every good option look like an accusation.

critic_line: A century of agreement is the most comfortable room there is.
